title: Newsletter promo
caption: The newsletter-promo recipe: an editorial card with the author avatar, numbered serif headlines, a subscriber badge and a subscribe button, for promoting a publication.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 6-second 16:9 promo for "The Magnifito Letter" in the newsletter-promo style: the logo mark as the avatar, "Sample issue · notes for small businesses", three headlines (writing subject lines people open, what a good landing page asks for, small budgets and careful ads), a "Free, once a month" badge that links to its claim in claims.json, and a Subscribe button. Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, the logo green #8acf31 used sparingly, Geist from fonts/, and the logo in assets/magnifito-logo.svg. Render it with HyperFrames.
credits: Geist typeface by Vercel, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (fonts/OFL-Geist.txt); TTF converted from the WOFF2 vendored in vendor/barty-motion-graphics
Headline serif: the renderer's system serif (Georgia, PT Serif or Times New Roman via fontconfig); not shipped in this folder
Magnifito logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg, from the Magnifito website): owned by Magnifito, the demo client; used with permission
